screen.player2npc.stt_consent.title: Enable Voice Input (STT)?
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.line1: While held, the STT key starts speech recognition in the Player2 app.
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.line2: The Player2 app uses your microphone for speech-to-text while the key is held.
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.line3: You can disable or revoke this at any time via Voice Settings.
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.line4: By accepting you consent to microphone capture and remote transcription.
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.enabled_ms: Voice input (STT) enabled. Hold the STT key to speak.
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.welcome_hi: Voice input (STT) is off by default. Hold %s to enable and provide consent.
screen.player2npc.stt_consent.revoked_ms: Voice input (STT) disabled. Consent has been revoked.
screen.player2npc.stt_settings.title: Voice Input (STT) Settings
screen.player2npc.stt_settings.revoke_hi: Revoking consent disables STT and clears your opt-in.
You can re-enable it by holding the STT key again.
